job: review the company tools catalog page where staff find an approved skill, check supported agents and install the package
primaryTask: Find an approved package by name or agent, read what it is for and its prerequisites, and copy its install command
verdictEvidence: Audit mode against http://localhost:3198/company-tools-fixture (Nucleus main 129aa62+, HOLLOWAY_VISUAL_FIXTURE). measure.mjs --cite tailadmin-tables: axe 0 violations; contrast 26 elements, worst 6.02:1 after excluding collapsed disclosure content; usability.mjs: find-shine and filter-agent flows passed (search narrows 5→1, Clear filters restores 5, Cursor filter shows 2). No usability or completeness defect survived; three craft/composition findings below are evidenced in measure.txt. The likeness failure (table occupies 0% of viewport) is a reference mismatch: the page is a five-card catalog under the 10-row grid threshold, so a table cite is the wrong comparison, not a page defect.

defects.problem: The primary accent colour is also used for non-interactive labels and badges, so one token carries two meanings
defects.evidence: measure.txt composition note: accent colour also used as non-interactive state on "SKILL LIBRARY", "Release: 1.2.0", "USE IT WHEN", "BEFORE INSTALLING", "Cowork setup & first", "Final"; screenshot shows the eyebrow labels and release/status badges in the same orange as the primary action
defects.expectedEffect: Eyebrows and status badges move to the muted/secondary tokens so orange means 'act here' only; the five Copy/Install controls read as the actionable elements at a glance

defects.problem: One of the two marked sections has no heading, so the page's second region is unnamed for assistive tech and for scanning
defects.evidence: measure.txt composition note: sections: 2 marked; 1 missing a heading (section.nx:text-foreground)
defects.expectedEffect: The section gains a visible h2 (or aria-labelledby to its existing eyebrow), matching the 'Skill library' region's labelled pattern

defects.problem: The agent filter toggles are narrower than the 40px minimum target on the 'All' control
defects.evidence: measure.txt composition note: 1 controls under 40px: button"All" 32×40
defects.expectedEffect: Filter toggles get equal min-width so 'All' matches its siblings and every target is at least 40×40
